svg.title: White-Balance, Color Priors, and Light Color Estimation Pipeline
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: top-left white-balance conversion, top-right color-prior extraction, bottom-left light-estimation update/chromaticity space, bottom-right LoRA-finetuned VLM light-color estimation. No SAM assets were supplied, so all photos, icons, cards, arrows, plots, and text are constructed as editable SVG.

g.desc: Inventory: three road-scene image panels arranged left to right; raw input I, current-estimation gauge and green bar, white-balanced W, camera-to-sRGB label, pseudo-sRGB image, black horizontal arrows, and a gray downward arrow from output into lower estimation section. Basis: left-to-right pipeline alignment with images sharing a common top edge and caption baseline.

Inventory: pretrained VLM block with visual/text encoders and LM decoder; instruction prompt panel; gray arrows connecting pseudo-sRGB image and text prompt toward VLM; title. Basis: horizontal split between model at left and prompt at right under a centered title.

g.desc: Inventory: chromaticity-space square heat map, black axes, labeled r/g and b/g, green/blue path with point estimates, dashed extrapolation, formulas for l-hat update, and small RGB vector triad. Basis: left plot plus right equations/triad, with bottom title centered.

Inventory: LoRA-finetuned VLM model at left, gray arrows from prior-extraction and prompt/prior panel, token row with colored prior squares, LM decoder, output arrow to Blue answer box, central left arrow, color-prior cards, prompt asking dominant light color, and frame title. Basis: model on left and priors/prompt on right; output centered beneath model.
